verses.text: Be careful that you do not forget the Lord your God, failing to observe his commands.
verses.title: What God Has Done

verses.text: Prologue: Exhortations to Embrace Wisdom Warning Against the Invitation of Sinful Men Listen, my son, to your father’s instruction and do not forsake your mother’s teaching. They are a garland to grace your head and a chain to adorn your neck.

Start children off on the way they should go,
and even when they are old they will not turn from it.
